title: Open-Hand Passing Game
description: Four receivers spread around the arc; only those with a raised hand are 'open'. The passer must find an open hand quickly, building the habit of looking before passing.

content.objective: Scan the floor and recognise an open teammate before passing, rather than passing to the first player seen.
content.setup: One passer at the top of the key; four receivers at the wings and corners.
instructions: Receivers raise or lower a hand on the coach's cue; a raised hand means open.
The passer scans all four receivers and passes to an open one.
The receiver passes back to the passer immediately.
Passing to a closed hand loses a point; count good passes in 30 seconds.
Make it harder by having the coach change open hands faster.
coachingPoints: Look before you need to pass: scan on the catch.
Pass to the open hand, not the closest player.
Keep the ball in triple threat while scanning.
commonMistakes: Passing too slowly so the hand drops.
Telegraphing the pass with the eyes.
content.safety: Receivers stay on their spots; passes are chest or bounce passes only.
progressions: Add a defender who tries to deflect.
variations: Receivers shoot when they catch with an open hand.
successCriteria: No passes to a closed hand.
content.gameApplication: Recognising the open teammate is the first passing decision a player makes in every possession.
